changes: Normalized the surname title from 'paṃtha' to 'Panta' (written as paṃthopanāmaka, i.e. 'having the surname Paṃtha'), kept as a surname-title.
Notes: added that the statement is a marginal addition in [[ ]] on fol. 10v, so it may be by a later hand and may not date from the copying itself.
Kept the commissioner role. The causative likhāpitam means he had the copy made, not that he wrote it.

notes: The catalogue lists Harinidhi Panta as the scribe, with a question mark. The colophon has the causative likhā〈〈‥‥〉〉pitam, which means he had the manuscript copied, so his role here is commissioner. The scribe is not named. The commissioning statement is a marginal addition ([[ ]], right-hand margin of fol. 10v), so it may be in a different or later hand than the main text. 'paṃthopanāmaka' means 'having the surname Paṃtha', i.e. the Brahmin surname Panta/Pant. There is no date and no place.
